title: SkillForge: Compositional Skill Synthesis with Verification-in-the-Loop for Generating Formally Verified Dafny Programs
abstract: arXiv:2608.29841v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generating formally verified programs from natural language remains challenging: existing approaches either produce code in a single pass without recourse when verification fails, or rely on open-ended agentic reasoning that is non-deterministic and opaque. We introduce SKILLFORGE, a framework that decomposes formal code synthesis into a library of atomic, reusable skills, each targeting a specific subtask such as specification inference, body synthesis, invariant generation, error diagnosis, or targeted repair, and defined by a prompt template, tool binding, and decidable success criterion. A verification-driven harness orchestrates these skills: it submits candidates to the Dafny verifier, diagnoses failures into structured categories, deterministically routes to the appropriate repair skill, and iterates until formal correctness is proved or a budget is exhausted. On a curated benchmark of natural language to Dafny specification pairs

translated_title: SkillForge：基于验证在环的组合式技能合成，用于生成形式化验证的Dafny程序
translated_abstract: 从自然语言生成形式化验证的程序仍然具有挑战性：现有方法要么在单次过程中生成代码，当验证失败时缺乏补救手段，要么依赖开放式的智能体推理，这种推理是非确定性且不透明的。我们提出了SKILLFORGE，这是一个将形式化代码合成分解为原子化、可复用技能库的框架，每个技能针对特定的子任务，如规范推断、程序主体合成、不变式生成、错误诊断或针对性修复，并由提示模板、工具绑定和可判定的成功标准来定义。一个验证驱动的调度器协调这些技能：它将候选程序提交给Dafny验证器，将验证失败诊断为结构化的类别，确定性地路由到相应的修复技能，并不断迭代，直到形式化正确性得到证明或预算耗尽。在一个精心构建的自然语言到Dafny规范对的基准测试上
tldr: SKILLFORGE将形式化代码合成分解为原子化可复用的技能库，通过验证驱动的调度器根据Dafny验证器反馈进行确定性路由修复，从而从自然语言生成经过形式化验证的程序。
en_tdlr: SKILLFORGE decomposes formal code synthesis into a library of atomic, reusable skills orchestrated by a verification-driven harness that deterministically routes repairs based on Dafny verifier feedback, enabling the generation of formally verified programs from natural language.
